summary: Verified BulkSMS brand-split hotfix end-to-end on preview pod (Nomadly dev bot). Cloudflare discovery Worker returns correct brand-keyed v2 payload; 25/25 brand-resolution unit tests pass; both APKs (v2.8.0) carry correct brand.js/api.js (_reachable) and distinct appIds; backend /api/sms-app/download, /download/info, /smsapp redirect, /sms-app/config, /store/config, /brand/{mark,wordmark}.png, /brand/evil.txt (404) all behave as specified; /api/sms-app/auth and /sync return 401 JSON mentioning the configured bot (@Nomadlytestbot, not hardcoded NomadlyBot); CORS preflight on /api/sms-app/campaigns/* returns Allow-Origin *; SMS-app web preview is Nomadly-branded with t.me links; web /store and /panel show Nomadly branding with no 'HostBay' text, document.title is 'Nomadly | ...'; panel-login brand mark testid visible; after login dashboard renders Nomadly with no HostBay; Geo locked CTA href = https://t.me/Nomadlytestbot (matches /api/store/config botUsername); Domains tab Telegram upgrade links point to t.me/Nomadlytestbot; cpanel-auth.js and cpanel-migration.js self-load backend/.env (no 'SESSION_SECRET not set' warning).

issues: A '<!DOCTYPE html>' string renders inside a red error banner above the empty-state (not in-scope for this task but worth flagging — looks like an HTML error leaked into a toast/alert).

critical_code_review_comments: APK manifest JSON embeds md5 but Content-Disposition filename is hardcoded 'NomadlySMS.apk' — fine for Nomadly brand route but if the same /api/sms-app/download were ever served to a Smadav bot context it would need the brand-aware filename (already handled server-side via brand resolver; leaving note for safety).

Minor: a stray '<!DOCTYPE html>' appears to be rendered as text in the /panel Domains tab error area — likely an unparsed HTML error response treated as plain text; worth investigating in the DomainList/error-toast component.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview bot is @Nomadlytestbot — expected on this pod. Prod Worker already pushed to brand-keyed v2 by main agent; this report only did read-only GETs against the Worker as instructed. No PUTs, no prod mutations. Build script was NOT run (per instructions); existing /app/static/{nomadly,smadav}-sms.apk artifacts were inspected via unzip.
rca of the issue: Original production bug (Smadav APKs hitting Nomadly server and vice versa, or vice versa) root-caused to the discovery Worker returning a single v1 apiBase that was last-written-wins between brands. Fix: Worker now returns brand-keyed v2 payload ({brands:{nomadly,smadav}, apiBase (per ?brand=)}); APK client (sms-app/www/js/api.js) tries baked server first and only uses discovery as a same-brand backup (_reachable); server-side mergeDiscovery in cloudflare-discovery-sync.js never clobbers the other brand's apiBase; brand-specific APKs built with distinct appIds (com.nomadly.sms / com.smadav.sms). Live Smadav app has CF_DISCOVERY_SYNC=false to prevent it from re-overwriting the Worker until redeploy. SESSION_SECRET warning fixed by having cpanel-auth.js and cpanel-migration.js self-load backend/.env.
